web.title: The Fascinating History of Milk Kefir
web.description:
Milk kefir is a fermented probiotic drink that is renowned for its healthful properties.

# Milk Kefir is Unique
Kefir grains resemble pieces of cauliflower, and they ferment the milk through breaking down the lactose into lactic acid and other beneficial components.
